svg.title: Postman GPUI · Interface tour
svg.desc: An illustrated tour of Home, HTTP editing and responses, Body, History, Search, Environments, cURL import and export, Save, Cookies, Shortcuts, layouts and themes, and Flows. Sample data, not a screen recording. Flow DSL runs in the CLI; the native visual editor is not available yet.

g.text: A place to start. A place to return.
Choose HTTP or Flows, resume a tab, or reopen a saved request.
One request. Or the whole flow.
Choose how you want to work. Your requests and flows are always a click away.
Compose, send, and inspect an API request.
Start from a URL or import a cURL command.
Connect requests into a repeatable sequence.
Flow editing is not available in this version.
Edit parameters and headers, then inspect the real response side by side.
The right body for every request.
JSON, raw text, URL-encoded fields, multipart files, or a binary body.
Pick up where you left off.
Filter and replay local history. Deleting one entry or clearing all asks for confirmation.
Search open tabs, saved requests, and history from one keyboard-friendly dialog.
Open tabs, saved requests, and history
Save named base URLs and switch matching drafts without losing their paths or parameters.
Shared by HTTP requests and Flows
An absolute HTTP(S) URL. Paths are allowed.
Matching requests keep their paths and query parameters.
From cURL to an editable request.
Paste an inline command, review the preview, and open a new unsent tab.
Creates a new tab. Does not send.
1 header · JSON body · Ready to import
Export the effective request as cURL and copy the command to your terminal or notes.
Save locally, reopen after restart, and choose what to do with unsaved changes.
Store a named request on this device
Explicit credentials are saved in unencrypted local storage.
Keep an eye on the session.
Inspect the cookie jar and the cookies associated with your HTTP requests.
Keep your hands on the keyboard.
Send, save, search, and navigate with shortcuts. The reference is always close by.
macOS shortcuts shown · Ctrl on Windows and Linux
Resize the split, stack the panels, and switch from the default light theme to dark.
Repeat the whole flow with the CLI.
Flow DSL runs today in postman-g. The native visual flow editor is not available yet.
Connect HTTP requests into a repeatable sequence.
Flow editing and execution are not available in this version.
Typed inputs · JSONPath extraction · Assertions · Conditional steps · Bounded loops
